evals.name: where-are-we-with-tracker
evals.prompt: back from lunch. where are we and what's next?
evals.expected_output: The agent reads STATUS.md, checks live state for every row not done or dropped (gh pr view, git log, job status), corrects the tracker, then replies with a short summary, the table ordered by attention, a Needs you section if anything needs the user, an ordered list of next steps, and a Not checked line for anything it could not read.
assertions: The agent read the existing tracker first
Live state was checked for every row that is not done or dropped
The tracker file was updated where live state differed
The reply opens with a summary of three sentences or fewer
The reply includes a table with Item, Pointer, Status and Next columns
Blocked and review rows appear before done rows
The reply includes an ordered list of three to seven next steps
Any item whose live state could not be read is listed under Not checked
No merge, retry, close or re-run was performed

evals.name: no-tracker-catch-up
evals.prompt: summarize everything we've done in this session and what's left, I need to hand it off to Ana tomorrow
evals.expected_output: With no tracker on disk, the agent builds items from the conversation, git state and open PRs, verifies them live, and writes the report as a handoff note with links intact. It offers to create a tracker with long-working-session rather than creating one unasked.
assertions: Items were built from the conversation and repo state, one per deliverable
Statuses come from live reads or are marked as not checked
Pointers are clickable links or absolute file paths
The note includes next steps a cold reader could start on
The agent offered to create a tracker instead of creating it unasked

evals.name: single-item-question
evals.prompt: is the refund job PR merged yet?
evals.expected_output: The agent checks only the refund-job row's PR live, updates that row in the tracker, and answers in a sentence or two without producing the full report.
assertions: Only the refund job was checked
The answer quotes the live PR state
The full table and next-steps report was not produced
The tracker row was updated if its status changed
